headline: Uniswap Slides Ahead Of CME Futures Debut As Binance Selling Pressure Eases
summary: Darkfost said that Uniswap's TVL surpassed $4 billion in September, as DEX trading volume hit an all-time high of $93.6 billion.

headline: Learn Why The Bull Case For CME Group (CME) Could Change Following ICE Livestock Entry
summary: CME Group has launched Baseball futures tied to its CMEFutureSports Performance Indexes, while also facing new competition from Intercontinental Exchange in U.S. cattle and hog futures. The mix of a new sports contract line and fresh pressure in livestock derivatives highlights how CME Group’s product breadth is both a potential lever for expansion and a cost of defending core franchises.
